correctness.rationale: The submitted wheel Laplacian theorem fixes nonnegative separate spoke/rim conductances, costs 1 and c, and B>0. Hub-versus-rim and paired first Fourier Rayleigh vectors give universal upper envelope min{(m+1)(B-cR)/m,[B+(κ_m-c)R]/m}; optimizing its two linear pieces yields the stated star/mixed/critical-segment regimes. For uniform weights the Laplacian eigenvalues are 0,(m+1)a,a+4b sin²(π j/m); equality of both first-harmonic Rayleigh quotients forces all rim rates equal from imaginary part and spokes equal from real part, even for m=3. Independently substituted sample m=3,4,6,7 and prices 0.4κ,κ,1.5κ into the formulas and the earlier publication after exact cost normalization; numerical real-valued identities agree. No correctness defect found.
